description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingNotCreatableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a 'Thing' cannot be created due to missing or invalid policy references. The class includes constructors, builder methods, and references to related classes such as 'ThingId' and 'PolicyId'.

classes.name: ThingNotCreatableException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating failure to create a 'Thing' due to issues with policy references. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ThingException'. It includes static factory methods and a nested builder class for constructing instances with detailed context.
